summary: Palmer Square Capital BDC Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 8.01, 9.01) on May 21, 2026, announcing its board approved a $30 million increase and extension of its stock repurchase program. The program now expires June 22, 2027, with $22.2 million already repurchased. The company intends to adopt a Rule 10b5-1 plan to acquire up to $10 million of common stock in open-market transactions. This is an open-market capital return program without a fixed price per share stated. Watch for execution pace under market conditions and insider selling patterns.
